title: US Measles Cases Reached 2,289 Again
closing: When vaccination gaps widen, measles can return to classrooms that thought it was gone.
question: Did you know measles had returned?

segments.say: US measles cases reached 2,289. A disease once eliminated nationally is spreading again.
Unvaccinated people made up 93 percent of cases. The comeback follows gaps in protection, not bad luck.
The Texas outbreak reached 702 cases. One vulnerable pocket can drive a large share of national spread.
